articles.title: Flaming Hydra’s new Kickstarter campaign rethinks e-book ownership and digital lending | TechCrunch
articles.summary: A new Kickstarter campaign aims to usher in the “return of the human internet.”
articles.body_text: Here’s a big promise: A new Kickstarter campaign aims to usher in the “return of the human internet.” That’s the tagline of a crowdfunding campaign for The Phoenix Project , an initiative from the online culture and commentary magazine Flaming Hydra . If you back The Phoenix Project, you’re supporting three things — a one-off print magazine designed to celebrate “the values and fun of the early internet,” a new e-book service for libraries, and a newsletter subscription/archiving program that’s also designed for libraries. To Flaming Hydra’s lead editor Maria Bustillos, these disparate projects are “basically all one thing,” tied together by the goal of “protecting freedom of information” and fulfilling the “promise of the early internet, where you’re making information available to as many people as possible, while still protecting the right of artists and authors to make a living.” Bustillos told me that these issues have been highlighted on Flaming Hydra itself, for example when Tal Levin wrote about finding countless AI-generated clones of his book on Amazon. By “creating an ecosystem that is based in people working together, who are offering their stuff in a context that is controlled and doesn’t allow” others to create and sell AI-generated clones, Bustillos said Flaming Hydra is “part of the human project.” “AI is not this unstoppable force,” she added. “If people just set up publishing pipelines and networks and organizations that are dedicated to the human internet, people who want to read stuff can go to them, and it’s actually completely isolated from mechanistic interference.” The Phoenix Project fits into this vision by making the work of human writers more accessible to libraries. Back in 2020, Bustillos wrote about the e-book systems dominating libraries and schools. In one example, instead of just buying a book, a school had to pay $27 per student per year for continued access to copies of “The Diary of Anne Frank.” This is symptomatic of a broader system that treats true ownership of e-books and other digital media as a thing of the past. Instead, we “license” these e-books from their publishers, and they can be altered or removed at any time. “E-books are books,” Bustillos said. “They’re not some other thing. They are books, and people should be able to own them, and libraries should be able to own them, and media should be able to be owned. All digital media should be able to be owned.” In her view, ownership boils down to a simple question: “If you are at the mercy of somebody who can shut the book off, you do not own it.” So even beyond the question of ongoing payments, there have also been examples of e-books being altered or removed from readers’ devices long after their purchase. Bustillos acknowledged that for individual pieces of media, this distinction may not seem like a big deal, “but if it’s all the textbooks for everybody, if it’s all the books,” then it’s a real problem. Flaming Hydra and The Phoenix Project seek to solve this by letting libraries truly purchase and own e-books. They can then lend those e-books to their patrons through a new, open source “library in a box” system called Lenny for Libraries .

articles.title: TechCrunch Mobility: The Nvidia backup plan for China's self-driving industry | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.
articles.body_text: I am traveling through Portugal now that Web Summit has wrapped up, so please enjoy this shortened edition. Web Summit leaned heavily into Chinese founders and companies this year. The opening remarks from Web Summit co-founder Paddy Cosgrave drove the point home when he said the superstars of the future are coming from China, not California. He also gave a strong endorsement of China and open source technology when he noted that Chinese companies are building more of our shared future than anyone else. These remarks carried a different kind of weight just a few days later as the news spread throughout the conference that Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang had resigned from his leadership post after admitting to an affair with an alleged spy. The former CEO, after all, has been one of the strongest proponents for open source in the United States. And anyone who has followed the emergence of autonomous vehicle tech knows how central Nvidia is to that ecosystem. Nvidia is a major supplier of AI computing technology to the industry — although the degree of reliance varies. Some companies are using Nvidia’s automotive processors to run automated driving software, while others are using Nvidia GPUs to train autonomous driving models. And then there are the full-stack partnerships, which includes Mercedes-Benz, Zoox, and Wayve. I spoke to Leo Wang , the CFO of Chinese autonomous vehicle company Pony.ai , this week. I asked him about the challenges China’s self-driving industry faces and what he thinks will happen if the fallout from Huang’s resignation results in even stricter export controls on Nvidia chips shipped to China. Demand is already far greater than supply, Wang said, noting that it’s one of the pain points Pony.ai struggles with. The company’s strategy is twofold. Engineers are directed to be as efficient as possible when deploying its training models. That might mean using midtier compute resources instead of high-end ones, he said. Pony.ai is also turning more to domestically produced chips to help close the gap. “If you look at the whole ecosystem, especially in recent years, definitely domestic chips in China also get lots of attention and development,” he said, noting that these chips provide another option for AI training. “I think that gives us some flexibility.” When asked what he thinks will happen if export restrictions on Nvidia chips tighten, Wang said Chinese companies have already been preparing. “If you look at the whole situation, this has been developing for already a couple of years,” he said. “Everyone, I would say, is also practicing kind of like a Plan B for a few years, so at least if you think about that, I would say there are alternatives. Although cost-effectiveness-wise, probably it’s not the best choice yet. But still, it’s an alternative way that already exists and which is more mature than a few years ago.” May Mobility plans to use the Volkswagen all-electric ID. Buzz for its global ride-hailing platform. The company said it is targeting the deployment of more than 10,000 autonomous vehicles through 2031. This does not mean that VW’s MOIA group is ditching Mobileye, I have been told. Instead, VW told me, the company is offering an automated driving-ready base vehicle to other companies that develop their own self-driving systems. (This was just presented last month during Nvidia GTC in Berlin.)

articles.title: The tech products we enthusiastically recommend this holiday season | TechCrunch
articles.summary: We've been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets at TechCrunch this year, and we have some clear favorites to share for your Black Friday shopping and beyond.
articles.body_text: We’ve been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets and hardware at TechCrunch this year: dumb phones , bird feeders , health trackers , slushy machines , AI mattress pads , you name it. Sometimes we think they’re unnecessary and expensive , but other times, we try out devices that we love so much that we go out and buy them ourselves. If these products can impress a group of (sometimes) curmudgeonly tech reporters, then they’re sure to please whoever you’re shopping for this holiday season. We’ve reviewed a lot of e-readers this year. What can we say? We’re nerds. We work for a tech website. But after trying devices from the usual suspects as well as some wildcards, we have recommendations. Evidently, 2026 was the year we fell in love with the pocket-sized e-reader. It’s an e-reader so small that it can fit in your wallet, or even magnetize to the back of your phone. Do you dream of a world where instead of scrolling Instagram when you’re waiting in line for coffee, you actually opt to read books? There’s really something special about the X3, and it’s only $55 during Xteink’s Black Friday sale. Fair warning, it takes some fiddling with to set up, and it has no integration with Kindle, Libby, or any other apps, so only buy this for someone willing to do a bit of Reddit browsing and tinkering to get it up and running. If you aren’t planning to magnetize the XTeink to your phone, you’ve got to go with the X4 Pro . It’s slightly bigger, but it has a backlight, which makes it way more versatile. After using both the X3 and the X4 Pro, I find that the backlight really is a game changer, since I do a lot of reading in bed — plus, I like my Pop Socket wallet a bit too much to displace for the X3, and I’d rather just carry an extra credit card-sized device than risk forgetting my actual credit and ID cards, which I have grown too used to having on my phone. If I’m being honest, reading my colleague Aisha Malik’s review of the Boox Palma Pro 2 is making me want to buy one. I love using the Xteink e-readers, but they don’t connect to any outside apps. As a hardcore Libby power user (a phrase I am saying in earnest sincerity), it’s a bit frustrating that I can’t get my library books on Xteink e-readers. The same goes for apps like Kobo and Kindle, where any e-book you already own cannot be transferred out of the Amazon ecosystem unless the publisher agrees, which most do not. If you’re looking for an e-reader with a screen that’s actually book-sized, my favorite that I’ve used is the Kobo Libra Colour , which is $259. The Amazon Paperwhite line is great, but c’mon, Amazon. Branch out! Hey, we’ve all got to eat. And if you want, you can make that eating process overly techy. Why not? The Ember Mug 3 is the latest iteration in Ember’s line of coffee/tea cups that actually stay warm. Our reviewer Lauren Forristal especially appreciated that you no longer need to use your phone app to change the mug’s temperature, which seems like it would be really annoying! This mug is perfect for gifting to someone, or to put on your own wishlist — you might not want to spend $99 on a mug for yourself, but these sorts of luxury, nice-to-haves are what holidays are made for! Ah, Ninja, the premiere company in the business of turning every appliance into a two-in-one air fryer. I jest, but at least Ninja knows it’s onto something. Despite the high price point, Lauren says that this new product made “a pretty convincing case for ditching two appliances and making room for one.” You can’t buy more counter space (without moving), but you can buy more versatile appliances. Sure, there are cheaper ice makers on the market. But Aisha clarifies that this is the ice maker for “those who crave what’s called ‘the good ice.’” If you feel so passionately about the ice in your beverages that you know what she means, then maybe this is for you.

articles.title: Where was Nvidia's security team? | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
articles.body_text: Outsiders had little reason to notice when Nvidia’s longtime chief security officer and head of product security stepped down in August. Just two and a half months later, CEO Jensen Huang himself left the company over growing questions about his extramarital relationships — starting with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore data center company that U.S. investigators suspect of funneling Nvidia chips to China, then widening to reports about two separate affairs with Nvidia employees. At the time, David Reber, who spent four years as CSO and seven at Nvidia overall, said he was leaving for health reasons. “This wasn’t a pivot I had planned. But I know what needs to come first: family and health,” he wrote on LinkedIn in late August, disclosing that he’d been diagnosed with young-onset Parkinson’s more than two years ago. Reber’s replacement, Saša Zdjelar, previously spent 17 years at ExxonMobil in Houston, leaving as a senior IT manager before spending one year at Salesforce and several years at the cybersecurity company ReversingLabs. Zdjelar didn’t respond to questions Thursday about the transition or what the security team knew. Nothing public connects Reber’s or Zdjelar’s role changes to the Megaspeed matter, but it seems fair to wonder what Nvidia’s security team knew about the government’s scrutiny of Megaspeed and about Huang’s relationships, and whether anyone raised concerns. Reber didn’t respond to questions Thursday. Nvidia also has not answered our related questions. Relationships between a CEO and his employees typically fall to HR, legal and the board, not security. But security specialists say any affair — even one inside the office — can give a foreign intelligence service leverage over an exec who wants it kept quiet. And Huang’s relationship with an executive at Megaspeed, a company under federal investigation, wasn’t an office matter at all. (Megaspeed has denied any wrongdoing.) Still, spotting the clues isn’t easy. The way intelligence services collect information, much of it through everyday conversation rather than hacking, makes it especially difficult for security teams to identify risks, according to retired senior intelligence officer Nicholas Eftimiades, who says he has trained more than 1,000 corporate security professionals. Some people inside Nvidia clearly knew parts of the picture. Nvidia’s top lawyer was engaged with the government’s Megaspeed inquiry more than a year ago, The New York Times reported earlier this week . (Nvidia has said it regularly contacts officials.) Reports about Huang’s relationships with employees suggest colleagues also knew of them, even if the behavior is not expressly forbidden by Nvidia’s code of conduct . The Times cited five Nvidia employees who said he was involved with a vice president who reported directly to him; Reuters, citing two people, later reported a second relationship. What’s unclear is whether any of that reached security. Even if it had, Eftimiades, who wrote Chinese Espionage Operations and Tactics in 2020, told TechCrunch that a security team’s resources are often limited. For one thing, they’re often underfunded because, unlike some other cost centers, they don’t drive revenue. It’s astonishingly common for CEOs to answer a security team’s warnings with “not a nickel more than compliance,” he said. Many companies also define security overly narrowly, specialists say. In an opinion piece in The Hill , Don Aviv, CEO of the corporate investigations firm Interfor International, and author Jeremy Hurewitz, wrote, “Too many companies still approach security primarily as a matter of protecting facilities, preventing cyberattacks, and responding to physical threats.” The two argued that “[s]ecurity teams need to pay greater attention to insider threats, including the cultivation of executives and employees by foreign intelligence services, suspicious business relationships, conflicts of interest and attempts to obtain sensitive information through trusted personal contacts.” It would be surprising if Nvidia’s security team didn’t have a more expansive remit than most companies given its scale and business partners, but it’s possible. In fairness, some of it is simply beyond what any team can do. Speaking generally, not about Huang, Eftimiades offered a hypothetical in which a CEO complains that he can’t do something because “I’m fighting a board who doesn’t want to do this.” That tells an intelligence asset who the obstacle is. The service then asks, “Who’s the sticking point here?” and looks for ways into that person’s email and phone. What a rival intelligence service wants is often less technology than policy insight, including who’s pushing to change export rules and who the biggest blocker is. “Intel world tends to be like cancer,” he said. “Once it gets into the body, it looks to spread and looks to reach out.”

articles.body_text: A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon. The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan. The petition states that its signers are “concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process” and demands that the board “bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.” It also calls on the board to ensure a fair investigation and provide more information to the public. “Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice,” the petition says. Huang resigned on Thursday , four days after confessing to having an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy. The former CEO has agreed to testify before Congress, while news reports have also suggested that Huang engaged in multiple extramarital affairs . Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement. Nvidia’s stock price fell sharply through the week, while Huang’s departure is also expected to leave a big gap in AI industry funding . Tech reviewer Marques Brownlee posted that buyers “must accept delivery” in one of a handful of Texas cities and that the Cybercab will only operate in certain geofenced areas. The estimated delivery date is December 2026. In addition to the $29,990 price tag, Cybercab owners will need to pay $299 per month to operate their vehicle. articles.title: Transportation secretary blames ‘routine’ equipment upgrade for grounding flights nationwide | TechCrunch
articles.summary: FAA administrator Bryan Bedford also said there's "zero evidence of anything AI-related."
articles.body_text: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday that a nationwide ground stop halting flights across the United States was caused by seemingly routine maintenance work. Duffy said that during “routine maintenance,” copper wire at a remote location was upgraded to fiber optic cable by L3Harris, a longtime contractor for the Federal Aviation Administration. After the upgrade, a router overloaded a critical communication system, leading to the ground stop. “It’s pretty straightforward work that we were doing yesterday at, again, a very remote location,” Duffy said during a Saturday press conference that appeared to have technical issues of its own . “What we’re working to determine was whether we had incompetence — meaning, was it user error or [installer] error from L3Harris? Or did they install a faulty router?” The FAA’s acting CTO Rebecca Guy added , “When we started to see the occurrence where our network was having instability, we started to look at what was the cause. And as such, we saw two places that were actually pinging our network at a very high rate — a thousand connections over every four to five seconds.” Guy said the FAA disabled “both of those, right away and were able to stabilize our network,” and is now performing a root cause analysis. Duffy has repeatedly insisted, at multiple press conferences, that Congress needs to provide more funding for aviation equipment upgrades. Asked why the upgrades were made at 3pm on a Friday afternoon — rather than, say, at midnight on a Saturday — he responded that while “switchovers” at bigger airports will take place late at night, remote switchovers happen during the day. “There will be reevaluation of when we do this work,” he said. This was only the third nationwide ground stop of the 21st century. More than 8,200 flights were canceled on Friday evening, according to aviation data firm Cirium . And the effects continued after the ground stop was lifted, with at least another 3,000 flights canceled on Saturday. The ground stop came just a day after the FAA announced the rollout of an AI tool for air traffic controllers; the air traffic controllers union said it was not consulted in designing the system. However, FAA administrator Bryan Bedford said the agency sees “zero evidence of anything nefarious and zero evidence of anything AI-related.” “We want to be clear that we have an equipment issue, and we’re working through what this defective piece of equipment was,” Bedford said. When Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin was asked earlier if the ground stop was caused by AI, he replied , “We call it SI [ super intelligence ] around here, remember? articles.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.
articles.body_text: Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia has drawn a range of responses across Asia, with some governments moving to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations. On Sunday, November 8, Nvidia’s board launched an independent investigation after reports that Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation; Huang admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed. Nvidia’s influence extends far beyond the United States. The chip giant has built close ties with companies worldwide, particularly in Asia, where many of its key partners play important roles in the global AI industry. China’s foreign ministry rejected allegations on November 10 that a Chinese businesswoman linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was a spy, calling them groundless and a smear against Beijing. On Friday , a spokesperson reiterated opposition to export controls that disrupt global supply chains and stated the ministry was not aware of reports linking restricted Nvidia chips to a Shanghai data center associated with Alice Huang. Huang’s exit has also raised uncertainty over more than $3 billion in Chinese AI computing projects reliant on Nvidia’s restricted processors, according to Reuters. Many of these chips are subject to U.S. export controls, making them difficult for Chinese companies to obtain. In Singapore, authorities seized the passport of Alice Huang, former CEO of Singapore-based cloud computing company Megaspeed, in June 2025 as part of an investigation into possible false declarations regarding server purchases, according to the Ministry of Home Affairs. The Singapore ministry said police took her passport to ensure she remained available for questioning, as she was not based in Singapore. The investigation examined whether servers shipped from Singapore to Malaysia were later sent to other countries without proper declaration. In February 2026, police found insufficient evidence to establish that Alice Huang had committed offenses related to the suspected false declarations, according to the ministry. However, authorities said she had knowingly provided inaccurate information about her role at Megaspeed. She was issued a warning and barred from re-entering Singapore. Her passport was returned that month. Singapore also said it received limited assistance from U.S. authorities despite repeated requests for information about U.S. server maker Supermicro. Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs said its investigation into Megaspeed and six other individuals remains ongoing. The ministry did not identify the six individuals or specify their alleged roles in the case. South Korea has close ties to Nvidia, with major chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix playing important roles in supplying memory chips used in its AI processors. Following Huang’s exit, South Korea’s Science Ministry said Nvidia had reaffirmed its plan to supply 260,000 advanced GPUs to the country and to continue joint AI projects. Apart from that, South Korea’s government AI strategy council held an emergency meeting on Friday to assess the potential impact of Huang’s departure on the country’s AI industry, per a local media report. Taiwan’s Economy Minister Kung Ming-shin said Huang’s departure was unlikely to significantly change the growth of the global AI industry, according to local media . Meanwhile, Taipei’s city government said Nvidia’s planned overseas headquarters in the city remained on track despite the leadership change. The company has met its contractual obligations so far, and officials said they would continue to support the project. In Japan, the Industry Ministry said the government would closely monitor Nvidia following Huang’s resignation, describing the chipmaker as an important player in Japan’s AI semiconductor industry, Reuters reported. Deputy chief cabinet secretary Masanao Ozaki said it was too early to assess the impact on the global AI industry, while stressing Japan’s commitment to ensuring a stable supply of semiconductors. articles.title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.
articles.body_text: Amazon recently unveiled its refreshed Kindle lineup , introducing a new basic Kindle , Paperwhite, and Colorsoft. The new Kindle Colorsoft starts at $290, while the Signature Edition, which I’ve spent the past few weeks testing, costs $320. The base model comes with 16GB of storage, while the Signature Edition doubles that to 32GB and is available in graphite or a maroon-like Fig finish with an aluminum back. Amazon first brought color to its Kindle lineup in 2024 with the launch of the original Colorsoft. The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. If you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade. The core reading experience remains largely the same. Both models have a 7-inch color E-Ink display, 300ppi resolution for black-and-white content and 150ppi for color. However, if you’ve been eyeing a color e-reader, the new Colorsoft is worth considering if you can get past the hefty price tag. Unlike standard Kindles, which display everything in black and white, the Colorsoft brings your digital bookshelf to life with their original colors. This makes it a particularly appealing option for readers who enjoy comics, graphic novels, or cookbooks, where color makes a big difference. It’s also great for readers who like highlighting passages in different colors. It’s worth noting that colors on the Colorsoft are still relatively muted and not as vibrant as what you’d see on an iPad. Still, they add a welcome splash of color and make a noticeable difference compared to the black-and-white displays of standard Kindles. The Colorsoft lets you adjust the screen’s color temperature, so you can switch to a warmer, more yellow-toned display that’s easier on the eyes when reading at night. There’s also an auto-adjusting brightness option that comes in handy. When it comes to battery life, Amazon says that the Colorsoft can last up to eight weeks on a single charge, compared to up to 12 weeks for the Paperwhite. During my testing, I didn’t have to stress about charging the Colorsoft because like other Kindles, its battery lasts a relatively long time compared to other everyday electronics. One small but welcome improvement on the new Colorsoft is the repositioned power button. On the previous generation, it was on the bottom of the device next to the charging port, making it easy to accidentally press it when handling the Kindle. On the new model, Amazon has moved it to the top-right edge, where it’s less likely to get in the way. I quite like this change, and found the new location more intuitive when powering the device on and off. I enjoyed the premium feel of the aluminum back on the Signature Edition. Although Amazon provided a case with my review unit, I rarely used it, and the finish held up well. While the slimmer design isn’t a major change, I found the new Colorsoft quite comfortable to hold compared to older Kindle devices. For those who enjoy reading in the bath or by the pool, the Colorsoft is waterproof, so you don’t have to worry about accidental splashes or spills damaging the e-reader.

articles.body_text: Centerpartiet riskerar en intern svekdebatt. Men partiledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist kan ha ett ess i rockärmen – för att blidka de värsta internkritikerna. – En lösning kan ju då vara att personen i fråga får en ministerpost, säger statsvetaren Jenny Madestam. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och Centerpartiet står inför ett svårt val. En svekdebatt finns runt hörnet oavsett vilken väg partiet väljer att gå, och situationen är inte helt olik den som Liberalerna redan gått igenom, säger statsvetare Jenny Madestam. – Nu står ju Centerpartiet inför samma vägval och bryderi som Liberalerna gjorde för ett antal år sedan. Och vi vet ju hur det gick för Liberalerna, att det blev väldiga konflikter och delar av partiet lämnade, säger hon. Men hon tror ändå att besvikelsen i partiet kommer att bli större om C gör upp med Moderaterna. – Jag tror att om man går åt Kristersson nu, då tror jag att det kommer bli mer konflikt eller besvikelse internt i partiet än om man väljer det rödgröna. För det rödgröna är den linjen man har hållit. Den linjen vet partiet om. Det finns de som är missnöjda med det, men antingen kanske de redan lämnat eller har förlikat sig med det. För Centerpartiet finns risken att tunga profiler tar ställning mot partiledningens val, och kanske särskilt om man väljer att stödja Ulf Kristersson, menar Madestam. – De som är extrema kritiker till att ta den vägen och som är starka profiler, typ Birgitta Ohlsson – en lösning kan ju då vara att personen i fråga får en ministerpost, till exempel. Det var ju det som hände med Romina Pourmokhtari som var extremt kritisk till att Liberalerna skulle ingå Tidösamarbetet med SD, men fick ministerpost, kanske för att kompenseras, jag vet inte. Att det i år är 50 år sedan Centerledaren Torbjörn Fälldin sa att ”ingen statsrådspost kan vara så åtråvärd att jag vore beredd att dagtinga med min övertygelse”, tror inte Madestam spelar någon roll. – Politiken har blivit mindre ideologibottnad, utan man är mer fokuserad på sina sakfrågor som man ska genomföra. Och i ett sånt läge är det kanske lättare att koppla från sig lite från sitt samvete. Men jag skulle vilja säga att för ingen i Centerpartiet heller är det här ett enkelt val. articles.title: Död man går mot valseger i USA
articles.summary: Bruce Giudici går mot valseger i ett distrikt i norra Kalifornien. Problemet: Han dog i augusti. Han kommer att ersättas – men ingen vet av vem.
articles.body_text: Bruce Giudici går mot valseger i ett distrikt i norra Kalifornien. Han kommer att ersättas – men ingen vet av vem. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Med bara några hundra röster kvar att räkna har kandidaten Bruce Giudici ett stort försprång i ett lokalt val i Calaveras County, som ligger i norra Kalifornien. Det bedöms vara nästan omöjligt för motståndaren Clyde Clapp att komma i kapp, rapporterar Los Angeles Times . Men i slutet av augusti råkade Bruce Giudici ut för en allvarlig olycka när han var ute och knackade dörr. – Han föll ned för en brant sluttning, slog i huvudet och dog nästa dag. Det var chockerande, säger Roberta Corso, kassör i Giudicis kampanjteam, till LA Times. Hans plötsliga bortgång lämnade hans kampanjteam handfallna och det var inte självklart hur de skulle gå vidare. Efter att ha undersökt olika alternativ insåg de att tiden för att ta bort hans namn från valsedlarna hade gått ut. Lagen i Kalifornien ser ut så att om någon dör mindre än 68 dagar innan valet så kommer namnet att stå kvar. Kampanjteamet bestämde sig därför för att fortsätta kampanja för Bruce Giudici. ”Bruce må vara borta, men hans vision lever vidare” , skrev teamet på sociala medier dagen han dog. Under resten av kampanjen fokuserade man på budskapet att en röst på Bruce Giudici var ett sätt att säkerställa att motståndaren Clyde Clapp inte skulle få makten. Vem som faktiskt kommer få makten är däremot fortfarande oklart. Om vinsten går till Bruce Giudici kommer någon annan behöva hoppa in som ersättare. Enligt kampanjteamet finns flera intresserade kandidater, men det slutgiltiga beslutet kommer att ligga hos guvernören i Kalifornien. Ersättaren ska väljas opartiskt och baserat på vem som kommer att agera så som Bruce Giudici skulle ha gjort.

articles.title: Gabrielsson (V) pikar C-ledningen: SD i regering 2030
articles.summary: Andersson eller Kristersson? C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist uppges driva på för att partiet ska gå högerut. Då måste man ”ge SD ministerposter 2030”, hävdar V-toppen Ida Gabrielsson på plattformen X.
articles.body_text: C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist uppges driva på för att partiet ska gå högerut. Då måste man ”ge SD ministerposter 2030”, hävdar V-toppen Ida Gabrielsson på plattformen X. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. I fredags eftermiddag fick Centerpartiet ”totalpaketen” från statsministerkandidaterna. På söndagen har partiet flera möten om vägvalet. Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och andra i ledningen vill dock att C ska gå högerut och ingå i en borgerlig regering, erfar Expressen. Vänsterpartiets vice partiledare Ida Gabrielsson skriver på plattformen X att hon har ”svårt att förstå” hur ett rödgrönt samarbete – även med V utanför regeringen – skulle kunna bli bra ”när ledningen i C egentligen vill något helt annat”. ”Men ärligt talat, vilken sida man står på avgör man inte kring sådant som vem som får ministerposter i ett samarbete. Du kan använda det som en ursäkt men det är också allt. Annars hade C stannat i våra samtal och försökt förhandla en lösning. Inte startat en utpressning om såväl samarbetsformer och högerpolitik.” SD har, till skillnad från V, backat från kravet om att ingå i regeringen. SD kommer att gå i opposition, men kan släppa fram en borgerlig fyrpartiregering. En sådan regering riskerar dock att få svårt att få igenom sin politik utan SD:s stöd, eftersom S+V+MP har klart fler riksdagsmandat. Samtidigt vill C inte ge SD politiskt inflytande. Politiker i S, V och MP har i flera utspel varnat för att en högerregering skulle bli helt beroende av SD. Det huvudsakliga syftet är att försöka påverka C:s vägval , enligt statsvetaren Jenny Madestam. Gabrielsson skriver också att C vet att de ”måste ge SD ministerposter 2030” om partiet väljer att samarbeta högerut.

articles.title: Inifrån Centerns ödes- vecka: ”Nu får vi se”
articles.summary: Regeringsbildningen står inför ett avgörande – när C väljer väg. Tre politiker har funnits vid Elisabeth Thand Ringqvists sida i förhandlingarna.
articles.body_text: Regeringsbildningens ödesvecka står inför ett avgörande – när Centerpartiet väljer väg. Tre tunga politiker har funnits vid Elisabeth Thand Ringqvists sida under den gångna veckans förhandlingar. Expressen kan nu avslöja vilka som suttit med i de hemliga rummen för de rödgröna partierna. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Den gångna veckan har S, MP, C och V haft en rad förhandlingar inbokade. Vänsterpartiet hoppade av måndagens möte, men deltog i onsdags . Därefter lämnade man åter samtalen. S, MP och C har däremot mötts vid en rad olika tillfällen och på flera olika platser. På agendan har legat att ta fram det totalpaket som C bett Magdalena Andersson (S) och Ulf Kristersson (M) om. Centerpartiet har under helgen analyserat svaren och ett besked om vilken väg man väljer, S eller M, väntas inom kort . Enligt Expressens källor har Centerpartiet inte avslöjat någonting för de andra partierna om vilken väg man avser att välja. Bland rödgröna personer är det en utbredd uppfattning att C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och hennes partikamrater har agerat konstruktivt och framåtblickande i de samtal som skett. Förhandlingarna uppfattas ha kommit en bra bit på vägen mot en gemensam regeringsplattform , med tyngdpunkt i frågor som välfärd, landsbygd, jobb, trygghet, människors lika värde och klimat. Samtidigt lyfter flera fram att C:s höger- eller vänsterval står i vägen för nästa steg. När partiet väl har bestämt sig, och om det sker vänsterut, så tror flera centrala källor att det kan gå snabbt att bilda en ny regering.

Om Centern går till höger sviker partiet sitt löfte om att inte samarbeta med Sverigedemokraterna, menar man. SD-ledaren Jimmie Åkesson har visserligen sagt att hans parti kommer släppa fram en regering med M, KD, C och L – för att sedan gå i opposition. Därefter blir det upp till regeringen att bland annat få igenom sin budget, menar han. Men en sådan regering skulle i praktiken bli beroende av SD, anser både S och V. – Det hade varit det största politiska sveket i modern tid, säger S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson. – En Kristerssonregering kommer bli helt beroende av Sverigedemokraterna. Man kommer inte kunna snyta sig utan SD:s acceptans, säger S-toppen Annika Strandhäll. Det får nu KD-ministern Jakob Forssmed att reagera och gå till angrepp mot S i ett inlägg på Facebook.

articles.title: Prinsessan Madeleine släpper tv-serie – inspirerades av kungen
articles.summary: Prinsessan Madeleine släpper en tv-serie för barn. På lanseringen avslöjade hon varifrån hon fått sina idéer. – Jag skulle säga att pappa har faktiskt varit en stor inspirationskälla till det här, säger hon till Hänt.
articles.body_text: Prinsessan Madeleine släpper en tv-serie för barn. På lanseringen avslöjade hon varifrån hon fått sina idéer. – Jag skulle säga att pappa har faktiskt varit en stor inspirationskälla till det här, säger hon till Hänt . Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Under pandemin satte sig prinsessan Madeleine ner med en kompis och började spåna på en tv-serie för barn – och nu har den blivit verklighet. På söndagen tog hon med sig två av barnen och maken till lanseringen av den nya serien med namnet ”Jakten på Nuna”. Förhoppningen med serien är att fler barn ska vilja vara ute i naturen och främja ett miljötänk. På röda mattan avslöjade hon var hon fått inspirationen från. – Gud, lite överallt skulle jag säga. Men jag måste säga att pappa har jag mycket att tacka för, säger hon till Hänt. Hon berättar att hennes pappa, kungen, var den som gjorde att hon själv fick ett intresse för naturen som barn, genom att ta med de kungliga syskonen ut i naturen och lära dem att ta hand om den. Men det är inte bara kungen som hjälpt prinsessan i den kreativa processen. För Svensk dam berättar hon att hon bland annat vände sig sonen Nicolas gosedjur – vilket resulterade i karaktären Mango, en liten flygande ekorre. – Den kom ju tack vare dig och jag tror barnen kommer tycka om den. Jag tror det verkligen, säger hon till sonen under intervjun. Hon har också haft barnen själva som en inspirationskälla.

articles.title: Nato flyttar fram positionerna – tysk brigad ska stoppa Putin
articles.summary: Den smala landremsan brukar beskrivas som Natos akilleshäl mot Ryssland. Här kan Putin skära av de baltiska länderna från resten av alliansen. Nu sätts 5 000 soldater med stridsvagnar in för att avskräcka från anfall. Expressen har besökt militärstaden som växer fram i rekordfart.
articles.body_text: Den smala landremsan brukar beskrivas som Natos akilleshäl mot Ryssland. Här kan Putin skära av de baltiska länderna från resten av alliansen. Nu sätts 5 000 soldater med stridsvagnar in för att avskräcka från anfall. Expressen har besökt militärstaden som växer fram i rekordfart. Nato rustar sin mest sårbara punkt: Suwalkikorridoren. Tyskland skickar nära 5 000 soldater till Litauen – Tysklands första permanenta utlandsstyrka sedan andra världskriget. Satsningen ska avskräcka Putin, men skapar också irritation bland boende nära den nya basen. På ett fält omgivet av en avverkad skog utanför Vilnius i Litauen växer en ny militärstad fram i högt tempo. Det är kanske ett av de tydligaste tecknen på Europas storskaliga upprustning. Här, på andra sidan Östersjön, ska Tysklands 45:e pansarbrigad – Litauenbrigaden – strida mot ryska trupper om det blir storkrig. Det är bara några mil till gränsen mot Belarus . Det är gigantiska summor som nu satsas. I Tysklands fall är det i praktiken ett helt operativt regemente som landet placerar utomlands. Enligt den tyska armén beräknas engångsutgifterna för försvaret i den inledande uppbyggnadsfasen uppgå till fyra–sex miljarder euro. De årliga driftskostnaderna beräknas till cirka en miljard euro när brigaden är fullt operativ. Infrastrukturkostnaderna står Litauen för, och den nu slutförda första etappen kostar cirka 125 miljoner euro. Den omfattar nästan 56 000 kvadratmeter infrastruktur, bland annat administrativa byggnader, lokaler för underhåll och förvaring av militära fordon, vakthus, kaserner och matsal.

articles.title: C pressas – möts i dag
articles.summary: Centerpartiet närmar sig sitt ödesbeslut. Under dagen håller partiet möte på hög nivå, enligt uppgifter. – Det är press på partiet, säger statsvetaren Jenny Madestam.
articles.body_text: Centerpartiet närmar sig sitt ödesbeslut. Under dagen håller partiet möte på hög nivå, enligt uppgifter. – Det är press på partiet, säger statsvetaren Jenny Madestam. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Centerpartiet står inför ett val: Kristersson eller Andersson som statsminister. Under söndagen väntas flera möten på hög nivå i partiet. Expressen har tidigare kunnat berätta att Centerns riksdagsgrupp har fått instruktioner om att snabbt kunna ta sig till Stockholm och delta i möten. Under dagen väntas också riksdagsgruppen samlas för att diskutera anbuden från M och S, enligt Expressens uppgifter. Även Centerdistrikten är kallade till möten på söndagen, rapporterar Aftonbladet . De ska enligt tidningen hållas av partiledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och partisekreteraren Hannes Hervieu. Enligt uppgifter till Dagens Nyheter finns det ett starkt motstånd mot Ulf Kristersson som statsminister ute i distrikten. Utgången är osäker, menar flera källor för Expressen. – Jag tror ärligt talat inte ens partiledningen vet hur det kommer att gå. Vilket egentligen talar för att man borde låta bli, när det är en så stor sväng som det handlar om. Det här är inte något man borde pressa igenom på det här sättet, säger en person som inte vill se en högersväng.

articles.title: Expressen Direkt
articles.summary: Expressens direkflöde med senaste nyheterna i korthet • Största nyhetshändelserna i Sverige och världen
articles.body_text: Centerpartiet har valt Socialdemokraterna, rapporterar Sveriges Radio Ekot. ”Vi har fått två seriösa och genomarbetade totalpaket för Sverige som visar på en vilja att ta ansvar och hitta lösningar. Jag uppskattar de konstruktiva och förtroendefulla samtal vi har haft med båda sidor.”, skriver C-ledaren Elisabeth Tand Ringqvist i en kommentar till Expressen. ”Inför valet sa vi att Magdalena Andersson var vår mest sannolika statsministerkandidat. Efter att ha granskat Anderssons totalpaket är vårt besked att Socialdemokraternas alternativ är det vi väljer att förhandla vidare om”, fortsätter hon. Thand Ringqvist konstaterar samtidigt att flera ”avgörande frågor återstår om politikens innehåll och riktning”. ”Vilket kräver att Vänsterpartiet släpper sitt krav på att ingå i regeringen och att de och Miljöpartiet står bakom det föreslagna totalpaketet. Vi ser nu fram emot att Socialdemokraterna skyndsamt tar nästa steg för att vi ska få fram ett regeringsalternativ med stöd i riksdagen.” Vänster eller höger? På söndagen har flera möten hållits på hög nivå i Centerpartiet. Vid 14-tiden samlades riksdagsgruppen och partistyrelsen för möte – och det pågår ännu, erfar Expressen. Från partiet är det dock locket på. – Vi kommenterar inte några möten. Vi återkommer när vi har något att säga, säger C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvists pressekreterare Olle Romlin. I fredags lämnade statsministerkandidaterna in de ”totalpaket” som Thand Ringqvist bett om. Hon sa då att man skulle gå igenom förslagen noggrant. SMHI har utfärdat en gul varning för plötslig ishalka längs Norrlandskusten. Varningen gäller från Kramfors till strax norr om Skellefteå, från klockan 22 på söndagen till klockan 07 på måndagen. ” Nederbörden rör sig österut och tidvis väntas regn eller snöfall som övergår i regn. På flera håll håller sig temperaturen på vägytorna kring minusgrader, vilket innebär risk för halka ”, skriver SMHI på sin hemsida. Myndigheten uppmanar trafikanter att ta det försiktigt och räkna med längre restider. Det finns även risk för förseningar och inställda avgångar i kollektivtrafiken.
